en: The image shows a picturesque riverside town with a prominent castle-like building situated on a hill. There is a river in the foreground with a path running alongside it, bordered by small houses. A horse-drawn cart is visible on the left side of the image. The colors and style suggest an early 20th-century hand-colored postcard. The text on the upper left reads 'Colditz i. Sa.' and on the right 'Partie an der Mulde mit Schloss.'
